title: Olive and the Best Stem
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 70-sound stage (st, sw, tr just added).

pages.text: Olive digs near the nest box.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl digging with one claw in the soil beneath her nest box.
Olive the owl noticing a bent green flower stem lying in the grass.
Olive the owl snapping the bent stem free with her beak.
Olive the owl neatly trimming the loose leaves off the stem with her beak.

pages.text: Olive sets the stem in a pot.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl placing the trimmed stem carefully into a small clay pot.

pages.text: Olive gets the pot to Fig.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying with the small pot towards Fig the caterpillar on a leaf.
Fig the caterpillar smiling at the pot Olive has brought him.

pages.text: Fig sets the pot near his den.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar placing the pot carefully beside his tree-hollow den.

pages.text: Olive and Fig smell the best stem.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar leaning in together to smell the flower on the stem.
